name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := fun hu hi =>
  let hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  let := InitStatesLength hi
  ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit this
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), by
    cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
    unfold updatedStates
    rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate hl
        (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
    simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
    intro k hk hk'
    cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
  ⟩

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  apply (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  by_contra hx₀
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hφ, hv⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
    (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Ici_mem_nhds (lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' hx₀)))
  refine ((hd.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hk.mul_right ?_
    (by rwa [hv, one_mul])).ne'
      (by
        simp_rw [← inner_smul_right']
        apply hg
        exact IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ contDiff_const)
  intro x
  by_cases hx : φ x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · apply mul_nonneg (hφ ⟨x, rfl⟩).1
    exact hs (subset_tsupport φ hx)

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j := electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t
  have hEd j k := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB j := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)
  have hBt j := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (hB j) x t
  have hs := DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hBt j)
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by decide)
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
    hJd x i (c := 𝓕.c) t
  have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [div_eq_inv_mul,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x), fderiv_const_mul
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        hJd t x),
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, Space.deriv_commute (u := i) _ (hEs _)] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hs.const_mul _) (hJt.const_mul _),
    fderiv_const_mul hs, fderiv_const_mul hJt]
  change (_ : ℝ) * ∂ₜ _ t - _ * ∂ₜ _ t = _
  simp only [Time.deriv_fun_sum Finset.univ _ (fun j _ => hBt j),
    Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (hB _),
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out),
    Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i _) (hEd _ i),
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, one_mul, mul_sub,
    mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀⁻¹ 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹, mul_left_comm 𝓕.μ₀⁻¹ 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (show
    (mulLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip c).compr₂ₛₗ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF) =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF) from
    ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun xs => ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun ys => ?_) a b
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.flip_apply, mulLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  obtain ⟨l1, l2, hs⟩ : ∃ l1 l2, ∀ l,
      (∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) →
      crAnTimeOrderList (xs ++ l ++ ys) = l1 ++ l ++ l2 :=
    ⟨_, _, fun l h =>
      (insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ xs l ys h).trans
        (List.append_assoc _ _ _)⟩
  simp only [List.append_assoc] at hs
  rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, mul_smul_comm]
  trans ι (crAnTimeOrderSign (xs ++ φ :: ψ :: ys) •
        (ofCrAnListF l1 * c * ofCrAnListF l2))
  ·
      congr 1
      simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm,
        smul_mul_assoc, ← ofCrAnListF_append, map_sub, map_smul,
        timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
      erw [hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]), hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])]
      rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
      rfl
  ·
      simp only [map_smul, map_mul]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
        (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
        mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      erw [← hs [] (by simp)]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
          hq.symm]
        rfl
      · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  have := der.wf.2.1
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => contradiction
  case sub der _ ih => grind
  case' app der r ih ir | tapp der _ ih | let' der _ ih _ | inl der _ ih |
      inr der _ ih | case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases this
    rcases ih ‹_› rfl with v | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' app.app.inl =>
    obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_abs v
    rcases ir ‹_› rfl with w | ⟨u, h⟩
  case' tapp.tapp.inl => obtain ⟨σ, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.case.inl => obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
    | left; constructor; assumption
    | right
      solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 8) only [*, Exists.intro, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs,
        Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, Red.case]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl =>
    econstructor
    constructor
    assumption
    constructor
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨_, hd⟩ := ihb hb'
    econstructor
    constructor
    exact hc.1.par hd.1
    exact hc.2.par hd.2
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par =>
    rename_i ha hb
    apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha
    econstructor
    constructor
    apply ParallelReduction.red_I
    assumption
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    econstructor
    constructor
    apply ParallelReduction.red_K
    exact h
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    econstructor
    constructor
    apply ParallelReduction.red_S
    exact (h.par hb).par (h'.par hb)
  iterate 3 all_goals econstructor
  all_goals assumption

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rewrite [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro s1 s2 hr
    cases hr <;> constructor <;> symm <;> assumption
  · intro s1 s2 hr μ s' ht
    cases hr <;> rename_i h
    case' choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
    case choice.choiceR =>
      exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      exact (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ =>
        And.imp (by first | exact id | exact Tr.choiceL) ChoiceBisim.bisim

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let j : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) j
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg_mem⟩, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := S)
    (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let Q := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩
    steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (s := Y.toFinite.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ)
      (Function.uncurry Q) ?_).trans_eq ?_
    · intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      refine ⟨(y, pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β j steps h_i_add_steps x),
        Finset.mk_mem_product (Y.toFinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩)
          (Finset.mem_univ _), ?_⟩
      dsimp only [Function.uncurry]
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl
    · simp only [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        ←Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card]
  have hb : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩ - 1 := by
    change 2 * (↑(sInf S) : ℕ∞) < _ at h_fw_dist_lt
    rw [←hg] at h_fw_dist_lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 j := by
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hb
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one] at h
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.sub_add_eq,
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))),
      Nat.sub_add_eq, pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps), mul_assoc] at h
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcard).trans h)
  unfold hammingClose
  exact ((ENat.mul_le_mul_left_iff (a := 2) (by norm_num) (by decide)).2
    (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f (C := C) g hg_mem)).trans_lt
    (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 hnat)

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [hp, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring1

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  intro ϑ hϑ
  induction ϑ, hϑ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    intro u h
    rw [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)
    simpa only [← @prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq F _ ⟨0⟩,
      multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using h
  | succ n hn ih =>
    intro u h
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA MC u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_) ?_
    · simp only [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at h
      assumption
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ :=
    (Set.Finite.pi' fun _ : Fin 4 => Set.finite_Icc B T).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
      (by exact fun n k => hB (n + k))
  refine ⟨i, _, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hn, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_of_le hij.le]
  exact Nat.strong_induction_on (n - i) fun m ih => by
    rcases lt_or_ge m 4 with hm | hm
    · exact congrFun he.symm ⟨m, hm⟩
    · rify
      simp (disch := omega) only [(hu _ (Nat.le_add_left_of_le hm)).1, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set]
  apply (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq ?_).mp <;>
    simp only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Finset.mem_coe] <;> try assumption
  clear hPP
  grind

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i)  := by
  have step {a b} (hab : relation a b) i :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.val - a i * 10 ^ i.val + digits_to_num a := by
    apply Int.dvd_trans (((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i)
    apply dvd_of_eq
    apply Int.sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, Int.sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f h i
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) fun i _ => step h.1 i
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Fin.sum_const,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d] at hs
  apply ((show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from by decide).pow_right
    (n := i.val)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  apply Int.dvd_trans (Int.dvd_sub (Int.dvd_sub hs (Int.dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d)))
    (Int.dvd_add (step h.1 i) (step h.2 i)))
  apply dvd_of_eq
  ring1
